children: The FMCG veteran brings over three decades of experience across business transformation, supply chains, digital innovation and ESG
Bajaj Consumer Care Limited has appointed Jitendra Mahajan to its board as an Independent Director, bringing more than 30 years of experience in the fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector.

Mahajan has previously worked with Marico, Britannia and Diageo India, building experience across business leadership and transformation. His professional background includes leading businesses with revenues exceeding USD 1 billion.
His appointment adds experience in business transformation, supply chain management, digital innovation and environmental, social and governance (ESG) initiatives to the company’s board.

Mahajan’s career spans more than three decades in the FMCG industry, with experience across companies operating in consumer products and beverages. His previous associations with Marico, Britannia and Diageo India have given him exposure to business operations and leadership in the sector.

His experience in managing large businesses and driving transformation is relevant to areas such as operational efficiency, supply chain strategy and the adoption of digital capabilities. His background in ESG also brings experience in an area increasingly relevant to corporate governance and long-term business planning.

As an Independent Director, Mahajan joins the board of Bajaj Consumer Care Limited, which operates in the consumer care segment. His appointment brings senior industry experience to the company’s board-level leadership.
Further details about his tenure, committee assignments and previous designations at Marico, Britannia and Diageo India were not included in the announcement.
